external_entities.name: customer company
external_entities.description: A customer organization using the invoicing service as a tenant.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app as an admin or viewer.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each user belongs to one company and is either an admin or a viewer.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The recipient of an invoice email who can open the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: A support employee who uses the admin console and can open billing-app sessions as customer users.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared invoicing application used by customer users, payment-page visitors, support agents, and PDF workflows.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A worker that consumes render jobs, reads invoices, and writes PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: The console used by support agents to open sessions in the billing app as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue carrying PDF render jobs with a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: To make a PDF, the billing app puts a render job on the render queue.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared bucket storing rendered PDFs under a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A customer user signs in to the billing app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They sign in with an email address and a password and get a session cookie.
data_flows.authentication: email address and password; session cookie
data_flows.data_description: Email address, password, and session cookie

data_flows.name: use billing app
data_flows.description: A customer user uses the billing app in a browser.
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customer information, and payout bank details

data_flows.name: open invoice
data_flows.description: A customer user opens an invoice by invoice number.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When a user opens an invoice, the billing app loads it by its invoice number.
data_flows.notes: Nobody wrote down whether it also checks that the invoice belongs to the user's company.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice selected by invoice number

data_flows.name: edit invoice
data_flows.description: A customer user submits the whole invoice back to the billing app for saving.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The invoice edit form posts the whole invoice back
data_flows.data_description: Whole invoice, including paid flag and payout bank account

data_flows.name: send invoice email
data_flows.description: The billing app sends an invoice link to the payer.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice link containing the invoice number

data_flows.name: view payment page
data_flows.description: A payer follows the invoice link to view the payment page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details
data_flows.notes: The payment page asks the payer to sign in to nothing.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice, company name, and bank details

data_flows.name: query and save records
data_flows.description: The billing app reads and saves tenant records in the database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.notes: The app connects with one database account for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customers, payout bank details, and invoice changes

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: The billing app places a render job on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the billing app puts a render job on the render queue
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: take render job
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer takes render jobs from the queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer reads an invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.data_description: Invoice selected using the job's company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer writes a rendered PDF to the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.notes: It trusts the company ID the job carries.
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDF

data_flows.name: fetch PDF
data_flows.description: The billing app fetches PDFs from the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.notes: The billing app uses one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDF

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A support agent signs in to the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code
data_flows.data_description: Account credentials and one-time code

data_flows.name: open user session
data_flows.description: The admin console opens a billing-app session as a customer user.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.data_description: Customer-user session identity

trust_boundaries.name: customer company
trust_boundaries.description: The customer company's organizational zone; each customer company is one tenant.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud-platform zone hosting the shared billing app, tenant database, and PDF bucket.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app, one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform.

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents work and the admin console is reachable.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

assumptions.assumption: The tenant database is confidential because it contains invoices, customer information, and payout bank details.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database contains every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.

assumptions.assumption: The render queue is confidential because its jobs carry a company ID and invoice number for rendering invoices.
assumptions.basis: The source states that render jobs carry a company ID and invoice number and are used to make invoice PDFs.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket is confidential because it stores rendered invoice PDFs containing business and payment information.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the bucket stores PDFs rendered from invoices, and the payment page includes bank details.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF renderer presents a non-web interface because it operates as a queue worker that takes jobs, reads data, and writes PDFs rather than serving a web application.
assumptions.basis: The source describes the renderer as taking jobs from a queue and processing them one at a time.
